d: LOCATION: Frasers Suites Seef - Kingdom of Bahrain

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced hospitality finance professional to make a meaningful impact within a dynamic and fast-paced hotel environment
q: Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field is an advantage.

Strong leadership, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and financial systems.

Frasers Hospitality, part of Frasers Property Group, is a leading global hospitality brand specializing in serviced apartments and hotel residences across Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. d: As a Data Analyst II at HungerStation, you will support the product development lifecycle by analyzing data, understanding user needs, and providing actionable insights that help optimize product performance.
You will work closely with Product, Technology, Marketing, Commercial, Logistics/Operations, and Growth teams to turn data into meaningful insights and support data-driven decision-making.
q: 2–4 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics or a related field.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a relevant field.
Strong SQL skills, with experience using BigQuery.
Python or R experience is required.
Basic knowledge of statistics and experience applying statistical methods to data.
Experience working with large datasets and data from multiple sources.
Experience creating dashboards and reports using tools such as Looker Cloud, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or similar.
Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for business and product stakeholders.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across Product, Technology, Marketing, Commercial, Logistics/Operations, and Growth teams.
r: li
Analyze product and business data to understand growth drivers and identify opportunities for improvement.
li
Develop analyses, reports, and interactive dashboards to support business teams and stakeholders.
li
Use quantitative analysis to uncover insights and help Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers understand what to build and why.
li
Work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources, including BigQuery, Redshift, and PostgreSQL.
li
Use SQL (BigQuery) and Python or R to extract, process, and analyze large datasets.
li
Design and analyze A/B tests by defining hypotheses, setting up experiments, and evaluating results using statistical methods.
li
Own data projects from data collection through to operationalization.
li
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Looker Cloud, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or similar visualization platforms.
li
Contribute to continuous improvement of data and analytical processes.

d: The Human Resources Manager is responsible for leading the development, implementation, and execution of the organization's HR strategies, policies, and processes to support business objectives, operational effectiveness, and sustainable growth.

The role oversees the full spectrum of human resource functions, including strategic workforce planning, talent acquisition, learning and development, performance management, employee relations, compensation and benefits, HR operations, employee engagement, and regulatory compliance.

The HR Manager will serve as a strategic business partner to senior leadership, providing expert advice on workforce planning, organisational development, talent management, employee performance, and retention. The role also requires comprehensive working knowledge of applicable labour laws and statutory requirements in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), and the Philippines, including pension regulations, social insurance, and statutory employee benefits.
Lead and manage the day-to-day operations of the HR department, ensuring efficient service delivery and alignment with organizational objectives.
Develop and implement HR strategies, policies, procedures, and initiatives that support business priorities and workforce requirements.
Partner with senior management and departmental heads to align HR objectives with business strategies and operational needs.
Establish, review, and continuously improve HR policies, procedures, and guidelines in accordance with organizational requirements and applicable legislation.
Identify workforce capability gaps and recommend appropriate recruitment, training, and organizational development solutions.
Provide strategic HR advice to management on organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, employee productivity, and people-related risks.
Lead the end-to-end recruitment and selection process, including workforce planning, job analysis, candidate sourcing, interviewing, assessment, and hiring.
Collaborate with departmental managers to identify current and future staffing requirements and define the skills, competencies, and qualifications required for each position.
Develop and maintain effective recruitment strategies and selection procedures to attract qualified candidates and ensure timely fulfilment of vacancies.
Advise hiring managers on candidate evaluation, selection decisions, and recruitment best practices.
Develop and implement talent retention, succession planning, and internal mobility strategies to support business continuity and long-term organizational growth.
Monitor recruitment effectiveness, workforce trends, and talent market conditions to enhance hiring quality and efficiency.
Review and evaluate compensation and benefits structures to ensure competitiveness, internal equity, and alignment with organizational policies and budgets.
Analyse market salary trends and recommend appropriate salary structures, incentive programmes, and employee benefits to attract and retain talent.
Oversee the administration of employee benefits, statutory entitlements, pension contributions, and applicable social insurance requirements across the UAE, KSA, and the Philippines.
Ensure HR-related payroll inputs, employee entitlements, and benefits information are accurate, properly documented, and submitted within established timelines.
Monitor changes in statutory benefits and compensation-related regulations and recommend necessary adjustments to HR policies and practices.
Identify training and development needs through performance evaluations, competency assessments, workforce analysis, and consultation with departmental managers.
Design, implement, and evaluate learning and development programmes that enhance employee capabilities, leadership effectiveness, and professional growth.
Establish development initiatives to address skills gaps and prepare employees for expanded responsibilities and future leadership roles.
Promote continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and internal career development opportunities.
Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements to maximize organizational and employee performance.
Develop and oversee the implementation of effective performance management systems aligned with organizational objectives.
Establish processes for performance planning, objective setting, periodic reviews, feedback, and employee development.
Support managers in addressing performance gaps, managing underperformance, and implementing appropriate improvement plans.
Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and performance excellence.
Advise management on performance-related decisions, employee development, and talent assessment.
Foster a positive, inclusive, and productive working environment that supports employee engagement, collaboration, and organizational commitment.
Manage employee grievances, workplace concerns, disputes, and conflict resolution in a fair, consistent, and confidential manner.
Advise management and employees on disciplinary procedures, grievance handling, workplace conduct, and employee relations matters.
Conduct or coordinate workplace investigations and ensure appropriate documentation, procedural fairness, and timely resolution.
Develop and implement employee engagement, recognition, communication, and retention initiatives to improve employee satisfaction and reduce turnover.
Provide guidance to managers on employee relations matters, workplace issues, and the consistent application of HR policies.
Develop and implement structured onboarding and induction programmes to facilitate the effective integration of new employees.
Oversee key employee lifecycle processes, including probation management, performance reviews, promotions, transfers, employee documentation, and separation procedures.
Ensure employment contracts, personnel files, HR records, and related documentation are maintained accurately and confidentially.
Establish consistent HR processes and service standards across the organization's operating locations.
Support managers and employees throughout the employment lifecycle, ensuring compliance with internal policies and applicable legal requirements.
Labour Law, Regulatory Compliance, and Risk Management
Ensure HR policies, procedures, and employment practices comply with applicable labour laws and regulatory requirements in the UAE, KSA, and the Philippines.
Maintain current knowledge of country-specific employment legislation, regulatory developments, and statutory obligations.

Oversee compliance with requirements relating to employment contracts, working hours, leave entitlements, probation, termination, end-of-service benefits, pensions, social insurance, and other statutory employee benefits, as applicable.
Review and update HR policies, employment documentation, and operational procedures to reflect legislative changes and regulatory requirements.
Maintain accurate employee records and ensure appropriate documentation, reporting, and record-retention practices.
Identify potential employment-related compliance risks and implement appropriate corrective and preventive measures.
Coordinate with relevant government authorities, external legal advisers, and service providers on employment and regulatory matters, where required.
HR Systems, Reporting, and Process Improvement
Oversee the effective use and maintenance of HR information systems, employee databases, and related HR technology.
Develop and maintain HR reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators covering headcount, recruitment, employee turnover, absenteeism, performance, training, and employee engagement.
Analyse HR data and trends to provide actionable insights and support management decision-making.
Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize, and automate HR processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and service quality.
Maintain appropriate controls over employee information, ensuring confidentiality, data accuracy, and authorized access.

Act as a trusted HR business partner to senior leadership and departmental managers, providing guidance on workforce strategy, talent management, organizational development, and employee-related matters.
Support organizational change initiatives, workforce restructuring, and business transformation activities, as required.
Advise management on HR best practices, emerging employment trends, regulatory changes, and people management challenges.
Promote consistent HR standards across all operating locations while ensuring compliance with country-specific legal and operational requirements.
Undertake additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned by management.

CMA CGM Bahrain is staffed with knowledgeable and motivated industry professionals who work closely with customers to deliver tailored shipping solutions and high-quality services. As part of our continued organizational growth, we are currently looking for a Sales Specialist to join our fast-growing and challenging organization.

The Sales Specialist is responsible for supporting commercial activities, managing customer portfolios, and driving business growth through effective quotation management and customer relationship development. This role works closely with Inside Sales and Outside Sales teams to identify business opportunities, promote CMA CGM Group services and non-maritime products, and ensure customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate will leverage strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and market knowledge to support sales performance and contribute to the achievement of business objectives.
q: University degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of two years of relevant experience in the shipping and logistics industry.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong account and portfolio management skills.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of customer needs and market dynamics.
Ability to identify business opportunities and contribute to sales growth.
Proficiency in MS Office and relevant commercial systems and applications.
r: li
Manage and develop an assigned customer portfolio to support business growth and strengthen customer relationships.
li
Oversee quotation activities through MyPrice, ensuring timely follow-up on pending, expiring, and unbooked quotations.
li
Analyze customer requirements and coordinate with relevant teams to provide competitive and tailored shipping solutions.
li
Identify opportunities to promote CMA CGM Group services and non-maritime products.
li
Support commercial negotiations and contribute to resolving pricing disputes and freight-related claims, including DDSM claims.
li
Collaborate with Inside Sales and Outside Sales teams to maximize commercial opportunities and improve sales performance.
li
Monitor customer needs and market trends to identify potential business opportunities.
li
Contribute to achieving commercial targets and improving customer retention and satisfaction.
